scenarios.description: A recorded game replayed from the deterministic command stream must reproduce the exact same world-state hash at every checkpoint. The replay hash must match the recorded fixture hash, proving determinism holds across re-runs.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Replay v2 and hash tests pass (replay reproduces recorded hash at each tick); determinism smoke test confirms two runs from the same seed produce identical state; analysis metrics are recorded in the report.

scenarios.description: A corrupted or divergent replay (truncated command stream, swapped tick, or non-deterministic RNG injection) must be detected and rejected — the replay result must report divergence rather than silently producing a mismatched but 'valid-looking' final state.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Replay v2 tests cover divergence detection; replay result tests assert that corrupted streams yield a non-OK verdict and that divergence is surfaced, not hidden behind a coincidentally-matching final hash.
